insertText.text: Sample deck for the Workday PPTX skill

One idea per slide
Six bullets at most
Core palette first, secondary colors rarely
Archivo for titles, Archivo Light for body
Leave the footer band clear
Frame the problem, the users, and the outcome before anything is built.
Ship a thin slice, review it with the team, and keep the scope honest.
Train the people who will run it and measure whether they actually use it.
